The Weight of the World | Episode 302 | Percy Jackson and the Olympians Official Podcast
Join the camaraderie between Aryan Simhadri (Grover Underwood) and Charlie Bushnell (Luke) with thoughtful character analysis. Charlie reveals the most intense workout of his life. He views on Luke as a failure-driven character. Leah Savage Jeffries loves exploring Annabeth's side away from Percy, noting Luke's nuanced care for his sister and Annabeth's subtle growth.

text:
Who’s the Most Powerful Demigod? | Episode 301 | Percy Jackson and the Olympians Official Podcast
Host Aryan Simhadri interviews Tamara Smart (Thalia) & Walker Scobell (Percy) about Season 3 Episode 1. They discuss their intense on-screen chemistry, one month prep for the opening fight, and how mirroring each other creates deep trust. They share behind-the-scenes stories: costume design for Thalia's road-worn look, stunt work with elite doubles, and the massive scale of this season. Aryan praises the season's darker tone, expanded cast, and standout moments.
